title: Instant 3D Gumball Drag
description:
Puzzle 3D gumball dragging is insanely slow and buggy. It should realtime-update the selection during drag and keep working correctly when used several times in a row.

Root causes to fix:
1. Every pointermove dispatches translateSelection/rotateSelection through full WASM + attraction resolve + document delta + VCS amend + React re-render (no transformBegin/transformEnd session in puzzle, unlike lowpoly).
2. SceneGumball resets pivot from gumballTarget on every selectionJson update mid-drag, fighting the live drag.
3. Async action races and stale pivot reset break subsequent drags.

Implement scratch-session transformBegin/transformEnd in puzzle plugin (mirror lowpoly), keep live instance preview during drag, commit once on transformEnd, and stop mid-drag pivot resets from fighting the gumball.
summary:
3D gumball drag (aggregator/puzzle3d) is now instant mid-drag like catalogue drag-and-drop.

Root cause: every pointermove still went WASM → scratch fixture → world composite rebuild → React instancesJson re-render, so meshes trailed the gumball pivot.

Fix: WorldInstancesLayer applies translate/rotate/scale imperatively to selected instance roots during drag (local preview, no WASM). World3dHost skips mid-drag transform ticks; on drag end it sends one absolute start→end delta then transformEnd. A commit-hold reapplies the final local poses until instancesJson catches up so release does not flash the pre-drag pose.

Verified: framework-renderer-react vitest (including gumballLivePreviewDeltaBetweenPoses) passed (249 tests).
